description: Generative and content-aware Remove (RM-20, RM-21): large objects whose fill is made on a coarser pyramid level, and hard scenes (water, building fronts, railings, tiled ground). Real photos are scored by blind picks and by measurements against their own surroundings; composites, an object pasted onto a clean part of a CC0 photo by research/prototypes/generative/make_removal_composites.py, also against the photo without the object. Every photo is CC0 from raw.pixls.us, each licence read from its repository listing (https://raw.pixls.us/json/getrepository.php?set=all) on 1 November 2026. Spots are in the photo's pixels as shown: a brush is its points and its radius, as `redlamp render --remove-brush` takes them in fractions.
